metadata.title: Clicked like I was chasing the Wi-Fi signal and somehow got 1 kill?! Valorant aim’s a glitch
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like my mouse betrayed me
Enemy: probably uninstalling in confusion
How did that even connect? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a lucky accident, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim ever surprises you mid-panic!
